map_features.note: Declared 103 W to 88 W eastern regional studied reach between two reported Subtropical Front crossings associated with the SPC in the source regional surface circulation. Front locations are proxies, not diagnosed velocity-core endpoints, and were observed in different years. OSW connecting vertices and alternatives are editorial. Branch correspondence is unresolved. Excludes Chatham Rise/western basin, ACC export branch, Peru-Chile coastal flow, northward recirculation and independent split bands. Not a whole-current or simultaneous observed axis.

widths.boundary_rule: Author reports band less than200 km wide. No numeric edge cutoff or geographic edge pair supplied; peak/sampled velocities are context only.
widths.extraction_method: Source qualifier and context transcribed after visual review of original pages. No source curve or edge digitization.
widths.geographic_scope: Western South Pacific near Chatham Rise; Baldrige section d at nominal170 W in March1990. Front station table gives170.6 W; exact width edges unresolved.
widths.layer: Enhanced eastward relative-geostrophic band in Figure3 upper1000 m context. Surface-intensified flow; exact width-evaluation depth unknown. No uniform vertical width slab.
widths.name: South Pacific Current

original_regional_context.display_aria_label: South Pacific Current: the authors report an enhanced eastward band less than 200 km wide near nominal 170 W in March 1990. Relative geostrophic reference sigma2=36.75 kg/m3 at 1800-1840 m. Representative width, exact days, lower bound and error unknown. No 200 km point, zero-to-200 interval, geographic width band or annual range.
original_regional_context.display_caption: March 1990 / Baldrige section d near nominal 170 W. Source-reported constraint for an enhanced eastward relative-geostrophic band; representative width and paired edges unknown.
original_regional_context.display_method_note: One reported less-than band constraint; representative width, lower bound, numerical uncertainty, mapped edges and annual extrema remain unknown. March 1990 dates the observation; 1995 is publication. The 100 km transport assumption and greater-than-500 km separation from ACC flow are distinct contextual values.

widths.range_interpretation: Reported enhanced eastward band less than200 km in one historical section. Representative width, lower bound, confidence limits, whole-current envelope and annual range remain unknown.
remaining_gates: Recover author boundary definition and exact evaluation depth before paired physical edges.
Acquire compatible repeated sections before seasonal widths or annual extrema.
